import subprocess, hashlib
p = 'corpus/knowledge/fleet-kill-rate-ledger.md'
log = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--format=%h %ad', '--date=short', '--', p], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.splitlines()
print('commits_touching_ledger', len(log))
prev = None
for line in reversed(log):
    h, d = line.split(' ', 1)
    t = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', h + ':' + p], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    a = t.find('## 1. Measured'); b = t.find('## 5. The instrument')
    blk = t[a:b] if (a >= 0 and b > a) else None
    dig = hashlib.sha256(blk.encode()).hexdigest()[:16] if blk else 'NO-BLOCK'
    print(h, d, dig, 'same' if dig == prev else 'CHANGED')
    prev = dig
